decision.reason: [ev-8f9ebb6885b8] is a one-line feature highlight. It says only that CEL expressions can now be used to evaluate dependency readiness for Kustomization and HelmRelease. It does not name the field, API version or controller setting that holds the expression, so the exact subject cannot be stated. It also gives no condition that would tell which environments are exposed. The surrounding section ([ev-522012cd49c1], [ev-3ade4dee13c7] and the other items) is just more one-line highlights with no more detail, and no upgrade-guide section is shown. To close these gaps we need the API docs or upgrade-guide text that names the dependsOn/readiness field and says how it behaves by default.
